observations: Two stethoscopes in original blister packaging.
The packaging features the brand name 'CHEGONGSHI' and a logo with Chinese characters.
Manufacturer text at the bottom reads 'HEFEI CHEGONGSHI... SALES CO., LTD.'
The chest piece is a single-sided cone/probe design, typical for mechanical or automotive use.
A watermark 'TOOLS AND HARDWARE WORLD' is visible across the image.

claims.claim: A stethoscope is a medical instrument used for listening to internal sounds of the body
claims.evidence: The cone-shaped probe design and the 'Tools and Hardware World' watermark indicate this is an automotive/mechanical stethoscope for engines, not a medical one.

risks.risk: The internal diaphragm or probe tip may be damaged or missing, which is not visible through the plastic.
risks.proof: A photo of the stethoscope out of the packaging showing the probe tip clearly.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the back of the packaging to see the full manufacturer details and model number.
A photo of the item out of the packaging to confirm the condition of the probe.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and type from the packaging. Although the seller describes it as medical, the physical evidence shows it is an automotive tool, and it can be priced as such in its worst-case (non-functional) state.
